fusions.name: Open Mouths
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and eats it. The strike deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scattered Spawn
fusions.desc: Looses 5 clouds of spawn in a wide spread, each dealing 10 water damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Catch
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and 1% more for every 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Preserved Surplus
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
